memberdef.name: SendFn

detaileddescription.para: Callback invoked for each eligible subscriber when a metric update is ready for delivery. The first argument is the client_id, the second is the JSON-serialised update payload.

briefdescription.para: Fan out update to all matching subscriptions.

detaileddescription.para: Push Metrics.

For each active subscription, the method:
Checks whether update.metric_name is in the subscription's metric_names list (empty list = subscribe to all).
Evaluates all MetricFilter entries (AND semantics); if any filter does not match the update is skipped for that client.
Enforces the per-subscription rate limit; if the last delivery to this client was less than update_interval ago the update is throttled.
Serialises the update to JSON and invokes the SendFn callback.
Thread-safe; may be called concurrently from multiple producer threads.

detaileddescription.para: Acts as the core dispatch layer for WebSocket / SSE metric streaming. Network I/O is decoupled via a SendFn callback so the class can be embedded in any HTTP/WebSocket framework without hard dependency.
Use formatWebSocketMessage() / formatSseMessage() to serialise a MetricUpdate to the respective wire format before handing the payload to the SendFn callback (or to any other transport).
